heroSubtitle: Restore soil function on wellsites, access roads, and lease areas. Terra Revive rebuilds biology and structure so native species establish faster, reducing re-mobilizations and closing sites on schedule.

problemSection.title: Why reclamation sites fail in Alberta
paragraphs: Soil function is an integrated set of biological, physical, and chemical processes that enable self-sustaining vegetation. When heavy equipment compacts soil or topsoil sits stockpiled for years, these processes break down.

Seed germinates poorly. Native species struggle to establish. Operators face costly re-visits and delayed site closure. Synthetic fertilizers provide a temporary boost but do not rebuild the underlying soil structure or biology.

solutionSection.title: How Terra Revive restores soil function
solutionSection.subtitle: Terra Revive pellets deliver organic matter, minerals, and microbial food sources that rebuild soil biology and structure. Applied at 2,000+ lbs per acre, the pellets integrate into the soil profile and feed beneficial microbes.

benefits.title: Rebuild biology
benefits.description: Organic matter feeds soil microbes that cycle nutrients and improve structure.

benefits.title: Improve structure
benefits.description: Aggregates form as microbes bind soil particles, improving water infiltration and root penetration.

benefits.title: Enable nutrient cycling
benefits.description: Minerals and organic matter release nutrients gradually, supporting vegetation without synthetics.

benefits.title: Support native species
benefits.description: Restored soil function allows native grasses and forbs to establish and persist.

methods.title: Broadcast
methods.description: Apply 2,000+ lbs per acre with a spreader truck or ATV spreader. Incorporate with light harrowing or raking if equipment is available.
methods.bestFor: Best for large wellsites and access roads where equipment can maneuver easily.

methods.title: Drill incorporation
methods.description: Apply 2,000+ lbs per acre with a seed drill. Pellets are placed in the seed row and covered with soil.
methods.bestFor: Ideal for sites with existing drill equipment and when seed and amendment can be applied in one pass.

methods.title: Hydroseeding
methods.description: Mix 2,000+ lbs per acre into the hydroseed slurry. Pellets suspend well and apply evenly across the site.
methods.bestFor: Perfect for slopes, uneven terrain, and sites where broadcast equipment cannot access.

methods.title: Drone
methods.description: Apply 2,000+ lbs per acre with agricultural drones. Pellets flow through standard spreader attachments.
methods.bestFor: Emerging method for remote sites and areas with limited ground access.
